name: Learned Sparse Retrieval
mechanism: Produces vocabulary-aligned sparse vectors with learned term expansion and scores them through an inverted or sparse-vector index.
use_when: Exact terms and semantic lexical expansion both matter
Sparse postings and term-level diagnostics are operationally available
avoid_when: The serving engine lacks efficient sparse scoring
Model or weights licensing conflicts with deployment
expected_effects: Better lexical expansion than BM25 alone
failure_modes: Index expansion increases storage and latency
Rare domain vocabulary is poorly represented
Aggressive pruning removes useful expansion terms
